title: Sequin and paillette fabric
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of sequinned fabric: overlapping metallic discs in offset rows, each with its own tilt, a dished face and a centre hole, over the backing mesh, including holographic foil. Use for evening dresses, stage costumes, party props, bags and glam set dressing.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python sequin_fabric.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: rows
parameters.meaning: Rows of sequins down the tile; as many sequins run across each row.

parameters.name: size
parameters.meaning: Sequin diameter as a multiple of the row spacing: the overlap between neighbours.

parameters.name: tilt
parameters.meaning: Random tilt of each sequin, which makes them sparkle differently.

parameters.name: hole
parameters.meaning: Radius of the centre hole as a share of the sequin radius (0 for no hole).

parameters.name: rainbow
parameters.meaning: Holographic foil: colour turning with each sequin's tilt direction and across its face.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Gold sequins packed like scales on black mesh.

presets.name: silver_party
presets.description: Silver sequins with strong random tilts for a lot of sparkle.

presets.name: holographic
presets.description: Holographic foil sequins whose colour changes with the tilt.

presets.name: black_gunmetal
presets.description: Small gunmetal sequins lying flat in tight rows.

presets.name: paillettes_rose
presets.description: Large rose-gold paillettes with small holes and a wide overlap.

limits: Sequins are flat discs with a sloped and dished height, one layer per row in a fixed overlap order; there is no stitching thread across the face, no loose or flipped sequins and no reversible two-tone sequins. Sparkle comes from per-sequin normal tilt in the normal map, so it depends on the renderer's lights and reflections. Holographic colour is a hue wheel driven by tilt direction, a stylized stand-in for diffraction, and does not change with view angle. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Offset-row disc packing with whole counts on the torus
Nearest-nine search with a local overlap order (row above covers row below)
Per-disc random tilt planes for normal-map sparkle
Dished disc height and bevelled rim
Hue wheel driven by tilt direction for holographic foil
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
